name: Musuko no Yome no Yuuwaku Ecchi ~Otou-san, Watashi Mou Gaman Dekimasen!~
original_name: 息子の嫁の誘惑エッチ ～お義父さん、私もう我慢できません!～
source: One night, Daisaku accidentally witnesses his daughter-in-law, Kaori, pleasuring herself. They make eye contact and return to their rooms awkwardly. Later that night, Daisaku wakes up to a strange sensation and finds a woman performing a sexual act on him. To his surprise, it's Kaori. She explains that she couldn't resist anymore because of Daisaku's passionate activities every night.
translation: 一天夜里，Daisaku无意间撞见儿媳Kaori正在自慰。两人四目相对，随后尴尬地各自回房。当天深夜，Daisaku被异样的感觉弄醒，发现一名女子正在为他进行性服务。令他吃惊的是，那人竟是Kaori。她解释说，Daisaku每晚热烈的房事让她再也无法克制自己。
